title: terminal_types golden's non-stable tail contradicts its demo's `expect hash stable` (flag parsed, never enforced)
evidence:
goldens/terminal_types.t1 (lines 646-647):
639 e0a8d19406fd36cc
640 93d35c5cc0c4db4e
demos/terminal_types.dem:40:
expect hash stable
harness/demo.odin:144:
	expect_hash_stable: bool,
harness/demo.odin:284-286:
		case "expect":
			if len(fields) >= 3 && fields[1] == "hash" && fields[2] == "stable" {
				d.expect_hash_stable = true
Repo-wide grep for `expect_hash_stable`: only harness/demo.odin:144 and :286 reference it — no read site.
detail: The new demo declares a stable-hash contract the blessed golden violates (tick 639 e0a8... vs 640 93d3...). The flag is parsed but never read anywhere, so nothing validates the declaration; if ever enforced (strict-arity precedent elsewhere in parse_demo), this golden fails.
recommended_fix: Either drop `expect hash stable` from demos/terminal_types.dem, or make the demo end in a terminal state (win/lose/pause) and enforce the flag in run.odin so the tail freezes; then re-bless.
